navigation.label: Processor
navigation.dialogDescription: Choose a Processor workspace for this location.
navigation.homeDescription: Find orders, resolve floor exceptions, and keep whole-order production moving.
navigation.intakeDescription: Review incoming orders, record physical intake, and release verified work to Production.
navigation.productionDescription: Advance started work from sorting through folding.
navigation.scheduleDescription: Plan ready orders and review additions to a live production run.
navigation.forecastDescription: Review remaining work, current capacity, and what needs another shift for a service day.
navigation.historyDescription: Review production runs, floor activity, and schedule-plan lineage.
navigation.configurationDescription: Manage language, appearance, and immutable scheduler inputs.

connection.offlineDescription: Current data remains visible, but server actions will not complete until the connection returns.

workspace.unavailableDescription: Refresh after the location has been configured on the server.
workspace.ambiguousRun: Pending orders need an explicit run selection because multiple production runs are active.
workspace.startSchedule: Start an accepted schedule before opening the production floor.
workspace.pageNotFoundDescription: This address is not part of the production workspace.

errors.loadProduction: Current production data could not be loaded. Refresh before making floor decisions.
errors.loadLocations: Production locations could not be loaded. Check your connection and refresh.
errors.unauthorized: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to complete this action.
errors.conflict: The production record changed. Refresh and review it before trying again.
errors.unavailable: The production service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned data the Processor could not read.
